trigger: An operator on a packaged (non-source) server follows docs/user-manual/upgrading.md 'replace the stored pack with the shipped one'; or an operator who already replaced the pack with a custom one follows it.
summary: The migration step names content/software-normalization/aliases.csv but the seed ships only embedded in the server binary (server/core/meson.build embed target; no GET route exposes it), so the file is reachable only from the source tree at the release tag, and the note does not say so. It also does not warn that a replace swaps out a custom stored pack (check loaded_by is seed in GET .../normalization/status first), nor that products created under an old vendor key (e.g. vendor Software AG, key ag:) are not re-keyed by a replace and a re-curation makes a second product. Fold: add two sentences.
classification_rationale: Required doc (item 2, docs/user-manual section for an upgrade step) exists but omits the source of the file and the custom-pack caveat; truth gap in a migration step, I7 MEDIUM, E3 per the I7 rule.

trigger: Any normaliser change after this one: the author bumps the seed pack_version as product_registry_store.hpp's banner instructs.
summary: The Normaliser contract banner says a changed normaliser REQUIRES a new pack_version (the job's <> arm then re-normalises every row). load_pack_if_empty never applies a newer seed to a stored pack, so on an existing server the bump does nothing until an operator replaces the pack by hand. SAM-51 documents that manual step (owner ruling 2026-11-21) but the contract and the mechanism still diverge for the next normaliser change. Proposed issue (decision): automatic re-key of a stored seed-loaded pack on a newer embedded seed, or state the manual step in the banner.
classification_rationale: Banner implies a seed bump is self-effecting; code (load_pack_if_empty) shows it is not for stored packs. I6 base MEDIUM, no raise (no security or integrity control advertised).

trigger: An operator needs to re-apply the shipped seed after upgrade with no source tree (packaged install).
summary: No REST route or MCP tool returns or re-applies the embedded seed: /inventory/software/normalization has status, queue, aliases, reject and a POST pack that needs the CSV body. The upgrade step SAM-51 relies on therefore needs a file the install does not carry. Proposed issue (task): an admin action that reloads the embedded seed, or a GET that returns it.
classification_rationale: A capability the documented upgrade step presupposes is absent from the product; I6 MEDIUM, E3, no raise (fails visibly).

trigger: A reader trusts the trim_wrapping comment when changing normalize_title.
summary: Comment on trim_wrapping says the emitted token is never rewritten; the new name@version split rebinds token to the trimmed name (probe: (openssl)@3 gives title 'openssl)' version 3, same root as #8462). Fold: reword the comment, or fix with #8462.
classification_rationale: Comment contradicts code on a classification helper, no security branch adjacent; I9 INFO.

summary: Fixed: docs/user-manual/upgrading.md now says the shipped aliases.csv is embedded in the server binary (take it from the source tree at the release tag), to check loaded_by is seed in the normalization status response before a replace, and that a replace re-keys no product.
Deferred: the Normaliser contract banner and load_pack_if_empty diverge for a stored pack; tracked in #8463.
Deferred: no route or tool returns or re-applies the embedded seed; tracked in #8464.
Fixed: the trim_wrapping comment in product_normalize.cpp now states what the code does; the wrapper-before-@ residual is tracked in #8462.
